description: The primary G38 case: a REENTER arrival carrying a non-numeric account filter, which is the only state in which this screen reddens anything. CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives as 1 - 88 CDEMO-PGM-REENTER VALUE 1 in app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy - inside the 160-byte payload communication area and nowhere else (gate G37, rule R6), which is what makes a REENTER path testable at all. CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM equals LIT-THISPGM, so :357-358 admits 2000-RECEIVE-MAP and :969-970 move ACCTSIDI into CC-ACCT-ID and CARDSIDI into CC-CARD-NUM. The REENTER arm at :459-460 is NOT the arm taken: it also demands CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM NOT EQUAL LIT-THISPGM, and WHEN INPUT-ERROR at :419 precedes it in an ordered EVALUATE (gate G30). ABC12345678 is eleven characters that clear the not-supplied guard at :1007-1009 and fail the numeric test at :1017. That guard reads both halves of the CC-ACCT-ID / CC-ACCT-ID-N REDEFINES pair over one eleven-byte span [app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy] - CC-ACCT-ID against LOW-VALUES and against SPACES, CC-ACCT-ID-N against ZEROS - so an alphabetic value in the X(11) view is exactly the state in which treating the pair as two independent fields, or parsing the span as an integer, would diverge (gate G34). The rejection arm at :1017-1025 sets INPUT-ERROR, FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK and FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES, moves 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER' [literal at :1022, MOVE at :1021-1023] into WS-ERROR-MSG PIC X(75) UNCONDITIONALLY - 2220-EDIT-CARD's mirror guards the same MOVE with IF WS-ERROR-MSG-OFF at :1056 and this one does not, an asymmetry preserved as found (practice B5) - zeroes CDEMO-ACCT-ID at :1024 and leaves through GO TO 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT-EXIT at :1025, a forward early exit that restructures to a plain return with its fall-through outcome unchanged (rule R7). The literal carries no space after its comma; that is how the source spells it, so it is reproduced rather than tidied (practice B4). CARDSIDI arrives as sixteen bytes of LOW-VALUES, so CC-CARD-NUM satisfies the very first limb of :1042-1044 and 2220-EDIT-CARD takes its blank arm at :1045-1047: it zeroes CDEMO-CARD-NUM and touches neither the error message nor its own NOT-OK flag, which is why only one filter is in error here. Every received item is stated at its full declared width rather than left to a default, LOW-VALUES where the terminal transmitted nothing (practice B8): a single LOW-VALUE byte extended by the PIC X pad would arrive as one binary zero followed by spaces, which is neither LOW-VALUES nor SPACES, and the two guards that read those items test them as whole spans. 2250-EDIT-ARRAY opens with IF INPUT-ERROR GO TO 2250-EDIT-ARRAY-EXIT [:1075-1076], so the INSPECT TALLYING and the seven-iteration EVALUATE never run: I-SELECTED stays zero and WS-ROW-CRDSELECT-ERROR is unset on all seven rows. NO BROWSE OCCURS, and that is the decisive expectation. The INPUT-ERROR arm wraps its read in IF NOT FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK AND NOT FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK PERFORM 9000-READ-FORWARD [:431-435] and the account flag is set, so there is no STARTBR, no READNEXT and no ENDBR - this case therefore contributes NO FileStatus outcome whatsoever (gate G47), and the fifty seeded CARDDAT rows come back exactly as seeded. The arm does still move LIT-THISPGM, LIT-THISMAPSET and LIT-THISMAP into CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET and CDEMO-LAST-MAP [:424-426] and into CCARD-NEXT-PROG, CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET and CCARD-NEXT-MAP [:428-430], but it issues no XCTL: the response's nextProgram is written only at the two transfer sites [:538, :566], so this case pins none of the three and terminates RETURN_TRANSID. Because 9000-READ-FORWARD never ran, its MOVE LOW-VALUES TO WS-ALL-ROWS [:1124] is beside the point - nothing ever populated the table, and the seven row entries arrive from the payload as LOW-VALUES across ACCTNOn, CRDNUMn and CRDSTSn together - so 1200-SCREEN-ARRAY-INIT finds WS-EACH-CARD(n) EQUAL LOW-VALUES on every row [:678-742] and CONTINUEs, leaving all seven rows at the LOW-VALUES that MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CCRDLIAO [:643] put there: CRDSEL1O, ACCTNO1O, CRDNUM1O and CRDSTS1O, and CRDSELnO, CRDSTPnO, ACCTNOnO, CRDNUMnO and CRDSTSnO for rows two through seven, are each width-many bytes of binary zero - distinct from spaces, which is what INFOMSGO and the error line's pad hold (practice B8). 1250-SETUP-ARRAY-ATTRIBS then finds its guard true twice over, LOW-VALUES and FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES, so every row takes the protected branch and the row-1 asymmetry the source actually contains is visible: CRDSEL1A receives DFHBMPRF [:753] while CRDSEL2A through CRDSEL7A receive DFHBMPRO [:766, :777, :789, :801, :812, :824]. Those are xxxA items of the INPUT group, not xxxC/xxxP/xxxH/xxxV output attributes, so they have no home in this case's attributes map and the suite asserts them directly; they are recorded here so the asymmetry is never read as a translation slip (practice B5). The '*' marker does NOT appear anywhere on this screen: its MOVE at :758 sits inside the ELSE branch, reachable only when row one is populated AND WS-ROW-CRDSELECT-ERROR(1) = '1', and neither holds - so DFHRED is present without any '*' beside it, which is the narrower half of what G38 has to show. The shared highlight mechanism reads the same way: app/cpy/CSSETATY.cpy reddens on FLG-(field)-NOT-OK OR FLG-(field)-BLANK and then adds '*' only IF FLG-(field)-BLANK, and only AND CDEMO-PGM-REENTER - so even under that template this account filter, which is NOT-OK rather than BLANK, would take DFHRED and no '*'. COCRDLIC does not COPY CSSETATY at all (its COPY list is :221-290 plus COPY 'CSSTRPFY' at :1416); :872-880 is this program's own inline variant, which reddens on NOT-OK alone, carries no CDEMO-PGM-REENTER guard and moves no '*'. This case is nevertheless in the REENTER state, so the highlight it pins is the one both readings produce - which is exactly the coincidence G38 asks to see demonstrated rather than assumed. The AID travels the shared route: COPY 'CSSTRPFY' at :1416 evaluates EIBAID and its first arm, WHEN EIBAID IS EQUAL TO DFHENTER, sets CCARD-AID-ENTER. 1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS takes the ELSE at :843 - EIBCALEN is not zero and the program did not arrive from the menu - and its account EVALUATE matches WHEN FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK at :846, so ACCTSIDO echoes the rejected eleven characters back verbatim [:847] instead of being blanked, and ACCTSIDA takes DFHBMFSE [:848]; the card EVALUATE falls through to WHEN CDEMO-CARD-NUM = 0 [:861] and moves LOW-VALUES into CARDSIDO [:862]. Then :872-874 reddens ACCTSIDC with DFHRED and aims the cursor with MOVE -1 TO ACCTSIDL; :877-880 does not fire, because the card filter is BLANK rather than NOT-OK; and :884-885 does not re-aim, because INPUT-OK is false. That is the whole of the highlight, which is why ACCTSIDC is the only reddened item on the screen and CARDSIDC carries no colour at all. 1400-SETUP-MESSAGE's first arm is WHEN FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK ... CONTINUE [:898-900]: it matches and does nothing, which is the order-sensitive fact of this case, since any later arm reaching WS-ERROR-MSG would overwrite the filter text (gate G30). :924 then moves WS-ERROR-MSG PIC X(75) into ERRMSGO PIC X(78), so the 52-character literal is padded by 23 spaces inside X(75) and by 3 more on the widening move - 26 trailing spaces in all. The trailing guard at :926-927 is false because WS-INFO-MSG still holds the SET WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE state from :669, so INFOMSGO keeps the 45 spaces moved at :670 and INFOMSGC keeps the DFHBMDAR moved at :671 rather than the DFHNEUTR at :929. Nothing abends: COCRDLIC contains no CALL 'CEE3ABD' and never moves anything into RETURN-CODE, so a validation failure completes normally and expectedReturnCode is 0 - gates G32 and G35 do not apply to this program. CARDDAT is seeded from the real fixture and asserted unchanged row by row at 150 bytes each, with CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE misspelled exactly as app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy:9 spells it and FILLER PIC X(59) space-filled across bytes 92-150 (I1, gates G19 and G21); CARDAIX stays declared-but-unused, one dataset and never a second table (gate G45). Page size seven is untouched here and is behaviour rather than configuration, so no page-size key appears anywhere in this case (gate G39). Every value above is STATICALLY DERIVED by reading app/cbl/COCRDLIC.cbl, app/cpy-bms/COCRDLI.CPY, app/bms/COCRDLI.bms, app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD, app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy, app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy, app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, app/cpy/CSSTRPFY.cpy, app/cpy/CSSETATY.cpy, app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy - whose ACTIVE CCDA-TITLE02 is line 22, line 21 being commented out - and app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt - NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution, which is empirically impossible in this environment (risk R-A, practice B12). DFHRED and DFHBMDAR are named as mnemonics from common/BmsAttributes, reproduced from IBM CICS documentation because DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from this repository (risk R-D); no raw attribute byte appears in this file.
